final: WITH gender_counts AS (SELECT c.gender, COUNT(o.order_id) as order_count FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.date_order_placed >= '2013-10-25 17:40:25' AND o.date_order_placed <= '2017-05-24 19:26:44' GROUP BY c.gender), average_count AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_count FROM gender_counts) SELECT gc.gender, gc.order_count, (gc.order_count - ac.avg_count) as above_average FROM gender_counts gc CROSS JOIN average_count ac WHERE gc.order_count > ac.avg_count ORDER BY gc.gender
